verdicts.reason: A centres the stack correctly, but it just shrinks the square layout into a narrow column in the middle of the banner. The headline is undersized for the format, the three lines are jammed together, and large side areas are left empty. B has the same problems, and its whole block also sits about 17px left of centre, so it looks misplaced.

Both are the same cramped centred stack with a small headline and wide empty margins. A's block drifts about 16px right of centre and B's drifts about the same distance left. Neither is aligned to the canvas or arranged for a left-to-right banner, so they are effectively equivalent.

A is a uniformly shrunk copy. The body copy is tiny, wraps and leaves 'next.' orphaned on its own line, and the PACEWELL tagline is illegible. Most of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the text readable on one body line with a clear headline, but it is still a cramped centred column shifted slightly left that doesn't use the banner width.

A sits about 20px left of centre. Its body copy is set smaller than the wide, heavy letterspaced tagline, so the sign-off competes with the message. B is also a slightly off-centre, tightly leaded centred stack with a small headline and empty sides, but its body-to-tagline hierarchy is a bit clearer.
